order_book: On the whole, our order book stood at ₹5,670 crores as of October, which is almost a growth of 13% over the same period last year.

focus: We believe we have been into a relative investment p hase over the last 2, 3 years, and therefore, we want to now stay focused on monetization of that and therefore, keep augmenting our cash flow position.
In H1, our investment in new verticals was ₹34 crores compared to ₹72 crores in the corresponding period last year, a reduction of 53%.
If I may recall for all of us, in financial year 2024-25, we had almost close to ₹168 crores of investment through P&L in new verticals.
